gas_scope: Every positive compiled gas member group, all three tranches. Reserve at most500MW per group in the four-hour window; remaining fleet retains original hourly bids. Synthetic packages, not identified real plants or conversion of all gas MW to unit commitment.
storage_scope: Three explicitly hypothetical added daily-cycle assets, initial=terminal=0 enforced rather than resetting an unconstrained stock. Charging parent/discharge child limits use accepted MODEL prices as a fixed own-model foresight reference, never observed-price targets. No claim about actual European storage fleet or investment value.
loop: Batch heuristic root rejection after an infeasible supporting-price check; reoptimize dispatch and prices. Retain original unrestricted allocation bound; later cut bounds do not certify global optimality of market-clearing prices. No cuts on numerical failures/timeouts.
time_decomposition: Couple hours6,7,16,17,18,19; other18 hours unchanged. Submitted profiles are zero between these hours and hypothetical storage has zero standing loss, so omitted periods have constant stock. Check all24 physical hours; energy balance spans the whole submitted storage cycle.
fixed: Accepted baseline inputs/bids, source weather/renewable availability, fixed hydro, demand, network/GSK/link limits, oil/coal/nuclear offers unchanged. No price fitting or public/baseline replacement.
reporting: Report source preparation, order generation/compilation, allocation, fixed-integer pricing, supporting-price search, iteration count, terminal feasibility, remaining cost gap and day/end-to-end wall times separately. Unknown/timed-out/invalid days remain failed; never call a partial job a full annual run.
